selection_contract.claim_boundary: single-optimizer paired development evidence only; no reward, training, cross-seed, or publication claim
selection_contract.component_gate: mean canonical component projection rate at most 0.25
selection_contract.expansion_rule: advance to fresh optimizer multiseed only if all three environments pass
selection_contract.failure_rule: any mechanics, component, or frequency failure stops expansion
selection_contract.frequency_gate: every environment requires at least 10% reduction in upper HPF8, lower LPF32, and normalized joint merit
selection_contract.mechanics_gate: all reward, executed-action, and latent-policy traces match exactly; explicit transition structure is valid; router and responsibility reconstruction RMS are at most 1e-7
selection_contract.paired_intervention: the same frozen checkpoint and heldout path is evaluated at strengths zero and one
selection_contract.training: one strength-zero policy with complete audit-plan state is trained once per environment
